name: 52297-sharegpt-35ba3b-dflash-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash as the speculative drafter.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, single node. Two cards because 72 GB of weights plus the drafter leaves an 80 GB H100 nothing for its caches; TP=4 is a safe fallback, PP is not a substitute.
architecture: Hybrid linear-attention + full-attention MoE (`qwen3_5_moe`), 40 text layers, 256 experts top-8, ~36 B parameters BF16 and ~72 GB of weights; the drafter is a separate 6-layer 385.9 M model, ~0.8 GB. Both read off the checkpoints' own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 200 warmup requests then 60 measured, safety cap 3600 s. Warmup dominates the wall clock: budget roughly 10-25 minutes of traffic plus the weight load.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 60 single-turn prompts, every request forced to exactly 300 output tokens with EOS ignored, greedy (temperature 0), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied. Materialised as `configs/data/sharegpt-60-out300-qwen36.jsonl` by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`: shuffle seeded 0, first turn of each conversation with at least two turns, 4 <= prompt_tokens <= 1024 and prompt_tokens + 300 <= 2048, tokenized without special tokens. 16410 prompt tokens in total, 18000 generated.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant giving 300-token answers from a 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a draft model on two GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# ON ONE LINE AS JSON, AND IT MUST STAY THAT WAY. The config reader is a line reader, not a YAML
# parser: it JSON-decodes a value beginning `{` and SKIPS every indented line, so a block mapping
# here is dropped whole and the engine starts with no drafter at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"model": "z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash", "method": "dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 8}

max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# RUNNER HAZARD: leave this false. On an SM90 card kernel warmup imports a FlashInfer autotuner
# entry point the pinned `flashinfer-python` does not export, and the engine aborts before serving.
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false
